  deliveryDate = '2026-07-25',
  notes = 'SOGO CWB Annie / UP920 (粉紅色) / 贈品：UPANG支架(送貨)、GOING BEAR包淺灰色'

  sku = 'UP920-PK',
  productName = 'UP920 粉紅色',
  color = '粉紅色'
